quick: 100 mg PO ~15-30 min before sex; range 50-200 mg once daily as needed
Not indicated in women / not for use in pregnancy
No adjustment in mild-moderate; caution in severe
Limit; additive hypotension with substantial intake
Blood pressure, erectile response, vision/hearing changes
summary: Avanafil is a fast-acting PDE5 inhibitor for erectile dysfunction, taken as needed about 15-30 minutes before sexual activity. It is absolutely contraindicated with nitrates and with riociguat/guanylate cyclase stimulators because of the risk of profound, life-threatening hypotension. Effective doses range from 50 to 200 mg.
indications: Treatment of erectile dysfunction in adult men

dosage.d: 100 mg as a single dose approximately 15-30 minutes before sexual activity, max once daily
May decrease to 50 mg or increase to 200 mg based on efficacy and tolerability
dosage.n: 200 mg should be taken at least 15 minutes before activity

dosage.c: With stable alpha-blocker or moderate CYP3A4 inhibitor
dosage.d: Start 50 mg once daily as needed

admin: Take orally as a single dose before anticipated sexual activity; sexual stimulation is required for effect
Do not take more than once in any 24-hour period
May be taken with or without food
Avoid grapefruit/grapefruit juice which may raise drug levels
Reduce dose when combined with moderate CYP3A4 inhibitors or alpha-blockers per label
moa: Selectively inhibits cGMP-specific phosphodiesterase type 5 (PDE5) in the corpus cavernosum. With sexual stimulation, nitric oxide release increases cGMP; by blocking cGMP breakdown, avanafil enhances smooth muscle relaxation, arterial inflow and penile erection. It has no direct effect without sexual stimulation.

absolute: Concurrent use of any organic nitrate or nitric oxide donor (regular or intermittent)
relative: Unstable angina, recent MI/stroke, uncontrolled hypertension or hypotension, severe heart failure (cardiovascular instability)
Anatomical penile deformity or conditions predisposing to priapism (sickle cell disease, multiple myeloma, leukemia)

preg: Avanafil is not indicated for use in women and has no role in pregnancy.
lact: Avanafil is not indicated for use in women; lactation is not applicable.
renal: No dose adjustment for mild to moderate renal impairment. Severe renal impairment (CrCl <30 mL/min) has not been adequately studied; use with caution.
hepatic: No adjustment in mild impairment; use with caution in moderate impairment. Not recommended in severe hepatic impairment (Child-Pugh C).

major: Organic nitrates / nitric oxide donors - life-threatening hypotension; absolutely contraindicated
Guanylate cyclase stimulators (riociguat) - severe hypotension; contraindicated
Strong CYP3A4 inhibitors (ketoconazole, ritonavir, clarithromycin) - large rise in avanafil levels; avoid
moderate: Alpha-adrenergic blockers - additive blood-pressure lowering; use lowest dose and stabilize on alpha-blocker first
Moderate CYP3A4 inhibitors (erythromycin, fluconazole, diltiazem) - limit to 50 mg/24 h
minor: Aspirin - minimal effect on bleeding time
interactions.food: May be taken with or without food; avoid grapefruit juice (raises drug levels).
interactions.alcohol: Substantial alcohol (>=3 units) combined with avanafil increases the risk of orthostatic hypotension; limit intake.

serious: Non-arteritic anterior ischemic optic neuropathy (NAION) / sudden vision loss
rare: Myocardial ischemia with sexual activity in at-risk patients
emergency: Sudden loss of vision or hearing
Severe chest pain or symptomatic hypotension after nitrate exposure

monitoring: Blood pressure, especially with alpha-blockers or antihypertensives
Erectile response and tolerability for dose titration
Prompt evaluation of any sudden vision or hearing change
Cardiovascular fitness for sexual activity in patients with heart disease
counsel: NEVER take with nitrate heart medicines (e.g., nitroglycerin) - this can cause a dangerous drop in blood pressure
Seek emergency care for an erection lasting more than 4 hours
Stop and seek care for sudden vision or hearing loss
Sexual stimulation is needed for the medicine to work; do not exceed one dose per day
Limit alcohol; tell your doctor about all heart and blood-pressure medicines
pk: Effective window up to about 6 hours
pearls: Fastest-onset oral PDE5 inhibitor (~15-30 min), making 'on-demand' dosing flexible
Absolute nitrate contraindication - if a nitrate is needed for chest pain, wait per cardiology guidance (avanafil has a short half-life)
Highly CYP3A4-metabolized: avoid strong inhibitors; cap dose with moderate inhibitors
Stabilize patients on alpha-blockers before adding avanafil and start at 50 mg
missed: Avanafil is taken on an as-needed basis before sexual activity, not on a fixed schedule, so there is no missed-dose schedule. Do not take more than one dose in 24 hours.
overdose: Overdose may cause exaggerated adverse effects such as headache, flushing and hypotension. Treat symptomatically with supportive care; avanafil is highly protein-bound, so dialysis is not expected to be helpful.
